2750.sigma:
title: Signal Desktop Linked-Device URI Invocation (UNC5792)
id: 6f3a1c84-9b27-4d51-bc0e-3a7e9f2d18b4
description: Detects Signal Desktop being launched with the sgnl://linkdevice device-linking URI on the command line, the device-takeover step abused by UNC5792/UNC4221 via doctored group-invite links. Legitimate linking uses in-app QR scanning, not a clicked URL handler.
references:
  - https://cloud.google.com/blog/topics/threat-intelligence/russia-targeting-signal-messenger/
  - https://www.ic3.gov/PSA/2026/PSA260626
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/27
tags:
  - attack.t1204.001
  - attack.t1098.005
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    CommandLine|contains: 'sgnl://linkdevice'
  condition: selection
falsepositives:
  - User legitimately re-linking Signal Desktop via a deep link
  - Red-team or security-awareness testing of the Signal linking flow
level: high
2750.spl: | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process="*sgnl://linkdevice*" by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | sort - lastTime
2750.falcon:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 CommandLine=/sgnl:\/\/linkdevice/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ParentBaseFileName, ImageFileName, CommandLine], function=count())

id: 4d8f2a6c-5b3e-4c7d-9a1f-2b3c4d5e6f70
status: experimental
description: Detects schtasks /create whose action targets SystemSettings.exe, used by StrikeShark for SharkLoader persistence (5-minute and 1-second triggers).
references:
  - https://securelist.com/strikeshark-campaign/120326/
  - https://cyberpress.org/sharkloader-targets-global-governments/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/25
tags:
  - attack.t1053.005
  - attack.t1574.002
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\schtasks.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - '/create'
      - 'SystemSettings.exe'
  condition: selection
falsepositives:
  - Admin scripting a Settings-app task (very rare)
level: high
2819.spl: | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name="schtasks.exe" Processes.process="*SystemSettings.exe*" Processes.process="*/create*" by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process Processes.parent_process_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | table firstTime dest user process parent_process_name count
2819.falcon:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/\\schtasks\.exe$/i
| regex("SystemSettings\\.exe", field=CommandLine)
| regex("/create", field=CommandLine)
| table([aid, ComputerName, UserName, CommandLine, ParentBaseFileName])

description: Runtime fetch of astral-sh python-build-standalone cpython-3.10.18 build 20250708 used by macOS.Gaslight to stage its Python stealer
references:
  - https://www.sentinelone.com/labs/macos-gaslight-rust-backdoor-turns-prompt-injection-on-the-analyst-not-the-sandbox/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/25
tags:

  product: macos

| `drop_dm_object_name("Processes")`
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
| sort - lastTime

2830.def:
// Article-specific bespoke detection — What nearly 10,000 developer environments reveal about agentic development risk
// Hunts the actual binaries / paths / commandline fragments named
// in the article instead of a generic technique-class template.
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where (FileName in~ ("skills.sh"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName,
          FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc

// File-creation events for the named binaries / paths
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified")
| where (FileName in~ ("skills.sh"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FolderPath,
          FileName, ActionType, InitiatingProcessFileName,
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc

            by AccountDisplayName, AccountObjectId, AccountType, IPAddress, ISP, CountryCode

2835.spl:
sourcetype=aws:cloudtrail eventSource="s3.amazonaws.com" eventName=DeleteBucket
| search NOT errorCode=*
| stats min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(sourceIPAddress) as src_ip values(userAgent) as user_agent by requestParameters.bucketName, userIdentity.arn, awsRegion, recipientAccountId
| sort - lastTime
2835.cloudwatch:
# log group: /aws/cloudtrail
fields @timestamp, eventName, userIdentity.arn, sourceIPAddress, userAgent, requestParameters.bucketName, awsRegion
| filter eventSource = "s3.amazonaws.com" and eventName = "DeleteBucket" and not isPresent(errorCode)
| sort @timestamp desc

2836.spl:
sourcetype=aws:cloudtrail eventSource="s3.amazonaws.com" (eventName=DeleteBucket OR eventName=CreateBucket)
| search NOT errorCode=*
| stats earliest(_time) as firstTime latest(_time) as lastTime values(eventName) as ops dc(eventName) as opCount values(recipientAccountId) as accounts dc(recipientAccountId) as acctCount values(userIdentity.arn) as users values(sourceIPAddress) as src_ip by requestParameters.bucketName
| where opCount>=2 AND acctCount>=2
| eval windowSeconds=lastTime-firstTime
| sort - lastTime
2836.cloudwatch:
# log group: /aws/cloudtrail  (organization trail spanning all accounts)
fields @timestamp, eventName, recipientAccountId, userIdentity.arn, requestParameters.bucketName
| filter eventSource = "s3.amazonaws.com" and eventName in ["DeleteBucket", "CreateBucket"] and not isPresent(errorCode)
| stats count_distinct(eventName) as distinctOps, count_distinct(recipientAccountId) as accounts, earliest(eventName) as firstOp, latest(eventName) as lastOp by requestParameters.bucketName
| filter distinctOps >= 2 and accounts >= 2
| sort accounts desc

description: Detects the PraisonAI async-jobs server started with a network-reachable bind (--host=0.0.0.0), exposing unauthenticated agent execution (GHSA-fq2m-6wqh-x44g).
references:
  - https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-fq2m-6wqh-x44g
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/26
tags:
  - attack.t1190
  - attack.initial_access
logsource:
  category: process_creation
detection:
  selection:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'praisonai.jobs.server'
      - '0.0.0.0'
  condition: selection
level: medium
2930.spl:
| tstats summariesonly count, min(_time) as firstTime, max(_time) as lastTime, values(Endpoint.Processes.process) as cmdline from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Endpoint.Processes.process="*praisonai.jobs.server*" Endpoint.Processes.process="*0.0.0.0*" by Endpoint.Processes.dest, Endpoint.Processes.user, Endpoint.Processes.process_name
| `drop_dm_object_name(Endpoint.Processes)`
| convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
| sort - lastTime
2930.falcon:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 CommandLine=/praisonai\.jobs\.server/i
| CommandLine=/0\.0\.0\.0/
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ImageFileName, CommandLine], function=count())

2931.def:
// Article-specific bespoke detection — [GHSA / CRITICAL] GHSA-j4hj-7hfh-g2f4: praisonai: recipe serve auth middleware s
// Hunts the actual binaries / paths / commandline fragments named
// in the article instead of a generic technique-class template.
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where (FileName in~ ("serve.py", "poc.py"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName,
          FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc

// File-creation events for the named binaries / paths
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified")
| where (FileName in~ ("serve.py", "poc.py"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FolderPath,
          FileName, ActionType, InitiatingProcessFileName,
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc
2931.spl:
``` Article-specific bespoke detection — [GHSA / CRITICAL] GHSA-j4hj-7hfh-g2f4: praisonai: recipe serve auth middleware s ```
| tstats `summariesonly` count earliest(_time) AS firstTime latest(_time) AS lastTime
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes
    where (Processes.process_name IN ("serve.py","poc.py"))
    by Processes.dest, Processes.user, Processes.process_name,
       Processes.process, Processes.parent_process_name, Processes.process_path
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
| append [
| tstats `summariesonly` count
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem
    where Filesystem.action IN ("created","modified")
      AND (Filesystem.file_name IN ("serve.py","poc.py"))
    by Filesystem.dest, Filesystem.user, Filesystem.process_name,
       Filesystem.file_path, Filesystem.file_name
| `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)`
]
